exam: 2021年6月 第1套 · 仔细阅读 P2
title: Being an information technology, or IT, worker is not a job …

sents.en: Being an information technology, or IT, worker is not a job I envy.
sents.cn: 做一名信息技术（IT）从业者，并不是一份让我羡慕的工作。

sents.en: They are the ones who, right in the middle of a critical meeting, are expected to instantly fix the projector that's no longer working.
sents.cn: 在关键会议进行到一半时，正是他们被指望能立刻修好那台不再工作的投影仪；

sents.en: They have to tolerate the bad tempers of colleagues frustrated at the number of times they've had to call the help desk for the same issue.
sents.cn: 他们还得忍受同事的坏脾气——那些同事已因同一问题反复拨打求助台而心烦意乱。

sents.en: They are also the ones who know there are systems that are more powerful, reliable and faster, but their employer simply will not put up the funds to buy them.
sents.cn: 他们同样清楚，存在更强大、可靠且更快速的系统，但雇主就是不愿出资购买。

sents.en: According to a recent survey, employees who have a job reliant on IT support consider IT a major source of job dissatisfaction.
sents.cn: 根据最近一项调查，工作依赖IT支持的员工将IT视为工作不满的主要来源。

sents.en: Through no fault of their own, they can suddenly find their productivity deteriorating or quality control non-existent. And there's little they can do about it.
sents.cn: 并非他们自己的过错，他们可能突然发现自己的生产力在恶化，或质量控制形同虚设，而对此几乎无能为力。

sents.en: The experience of using IT penetrates almost the entire work field.
sents.cn: 使用IT的体验几乎渗透整个工作领域，它已成为员工整体工作体验中至关重要的一部分。

sents.en: It has become a crucial part of employees' overall work experience. When IT is operating as it should, employee self-confidence swells.
sents.cn: 当IT正常运转时，员工的自信心会增强；

sents.en: Their job satisfaction, too, can surge when well-functioning machines relieve them of dull tasks or repetitive processes.
sents.cn: 当运转良好的机器把他们从枯燥或重复的工作中解脱出来时，他们的工作满意度也会飙升。

sents.en: But if there's one thing that triggers widespread employee frustration, it's an IT transformation project gone wrong, where swollen expectations have been popped and a long list of promised efficiencies have been reversed. This occurs when business leaders implement IT initiatives with little consideration of how those changes will impact the end user.
sents.cn: 但要说有什么会引发员工的普遍挫败感，那就是出了差错的IT转型项目——被吹大的期望破灭，一长串承诺的效率化为乌有。这种情况发生在企业领导者推行IT方案时，几乎不考虑这些变更将如何影响最终用户。

sents.en: Which is why managers should appreciate just how influential the IT user experience is to their employees, and exert substantial effort in ensuring their IT team eliminates programming errors and application crashes.
sents.cn: 正因如此，管理者应当理解IT用户体验对员工的巨大影响力，并付出切实努力，确保其IT团队消除编程错误与应用程序崩溃。

sents.en: Adequate and timely IT support should also be available to enable users to cope with technological issues at work.
sents.cn: 还应提供充分而及时的IT支持，帮助用户应对工作中的技术问题。

sents.en: More importantly, IT practitioners need to understand what employees experience mentally when they use IT.
sents.cn: 更重要的是，IT从业者需要理解员工在使用IT时心里的真实感受。

sents.en: Therefore, businesses need to set up their IT infrastructure so that it is designed to fit in with their employees' work, rather than adjust their work to fit in with the company's IT limitations.
sents.cn: 因此，企业应当建立其IT基础设施，使其设计契合员工的工作，而不是让员工调整自己的工作去迁就公司的IT局限。
